sentences.en: Hello and welcome to today's 'Buyer Beware' programme, where we give you some tips on how to spend your money wisely.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听今天的《买家当心》节目，我们将为您提供一些明智消费的建议。

sentences.en: Now, in today's show we're looking at beds for children and babies.
sentences.zh: 今天节目中，我们将关注儿童及婴儿用床。

sentences.en: Let's start by looking at baby cots, that's for children of up to three years old.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们来看看婴儿床，适用于三岁以下的婴幼儿。

sentences.en: We www.TopSage.com Tapescripts † AN tested three different cots all in the budget price range and, as usual, we will feature the good points, the problems and our verdict.
sentences.zh: 我们在www.TopSage.com网站上测试了三款不同品牌的婴儿床，价格均在预算范围内；和往常一样，我们将介绍它们的优点、存在的问题以及我们的最终评价。

sentences.en: TopSage.com The first cot we looked at was by Baby Safe and it had several good points to recommend it.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 首先测试的是Baby Safe品牌的婴儿床，该产品具备多项值得推荐的优点。

sentences.en: Our testers liked the fact that it had four wheels, so it was easy to move around.
sentences.zh: 我们的测试人员很喜欢它配备的四个轮子，因此移动起来非常方便。

sentences.en: The only slight problems with this cot were that it had no brakes, but they didn't think that mattered too much.
sentences.zh: 这款婴儿床唯一的轻微问题是未配备刹车装置，但测试人员并不认为这会造成太大影响。

sentences.en: At first they were a bit concerned about the side bar, because they felt babies could trap their fingers in it, but our testers felt that this was unlikely to happen so they have given this one a verdict of 'satisfactory'.
sentences.zh: 起初，测试人员对侧栏略感担忧，因为他们担心婴儿可能将手指卡在其中；不过，我们的测试员觉得这种情况不太可能发生，因此给予该款婴儿床“合格”的评价。

sentences.en: The next cot was by Choice Cots and this time our testers were pleased to find a cot which is simple to put together - unlike others we looked at.
sentences.zh: 第二款婴儿床来自Choice Cots品牌，此次测试员很高兴地发现，这款床组装起来十分简便——与其他我们测试过的款式不同。

sentences.en: On the minus side, our testers did not like the fact that the side of the cot did not drop down, making it difficult to pick up newborn babies.
sentences.zh: 但其缺点在于婴儿床侧面无法下落，导致抱起新生儿时颇为不便。

sentences.en: However, the real problem with this cot was the space between the bars; our testers found they were too wide and a baby could easily trap his head.
sentences.zh: 然而，这款婴儿床真正的隐患在于栏杆间距：测试员发现栏杆间隙过大，婴儿极易将头部卡住。

sentences.en: We felt this was a real safety hazard and so we have labelled this one dangerous, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这构成了严重的安全隐患，因此不得不将其标注为‘危险’。

sentences.en: And finally better news for the Mother's Choice cot.
sentences.zh: 最后，好消息属于Mother's Choice品牌的婴儿床。

sentences.en: This cot was slightly different in that, although the side bar did not drop down, the base could be raised or lowered into two different positions making it safe as well as convenient.
sentences.zh: 这款婴儿床略有不同：虽然其侧栏不能下落，但床板基座可升可降，设有两个不同高度位置，既安全又便捷。

sentences.en: The negatives for this one were quite minor; the only niggle everyone had was the fact that it has no wheels and the only other problem anyone could find, was that there were pictures which were simply stuck on and so could easily become detached.
sentences.zh: 这款婴儿床的不足之处相当轻微：大家共同提出的一点小意见是它没有轮子；而其他人所能发现的唯一其他问题，则是附着在床体上的图案仅靠粘贴固定，因而极易脱落。

sentences.en: The makers have now promised to discontinue this practice.
sentences.zh: 制造商现已承诺停止采用这种粘贴方式。

sentences.en: As this cot will then be safe in every way, we have made the Mother's Choice cot our best buy.
sentences.zh: 鉴于该婴儿床经改进后将在各方面都确保安全，我们将其评为‘最佳选购推荐’。

sentences.en: Congratulations Mother's Choice!
sentences.zh: 祝贺Mother's Choice！

sentences.en: So, what features should you look for in a baby's cot?
sentences.zh: 那么，选购婴儿床时应重点关注哪些特性呢？

sentences.en: Well obviously safety is a very important factor as well as comfort and convenience.
sentences.zh: 显然，安全性是极为重要的因素，此外舒适性与便利性也不容忽视。

sentences.en: We recommend that, if you are buying a cot, do make sure that any metal present is not rusted or bent in any way.
sentences.zh: 我们建议：若您购买婴儿床，请务必确认所有金属部件均无锈蚀或弯曲现象。

sentences.en: You should ensure your cot has only rounded or smooth edging without any sharp edges, this is especially important for wooden cots.
sentences.zh: 您还应确保婴儿床仅具有圆角或光滑边缘，不得有任何尖锐棱角——这一点对于木制婴儿床尤为重要。

sentences.en: And now on to beds for toddlers . . .
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们转向学步期幼儿用床……
